name: Machine Preacher Curl
steps: Adjust the seat so your elbows align with the pivot and your upper arms rest on the angled pad.
Grasp the handles with your palms up and let your arms extend without forcing your elbows straight.
Curl the handles smoothly upward toward your shoulders by contracting your biceps firmly.
Lower the handles slowly back down to the stretched position without resting the stack.
tips: Keep your elbows glued to the pad instead of leaning backward to assist the lift.
Keep your wrists flat rather than curling them inward at the top.
